aboutpara: At Intercom, a $350M ARR company, I build conversational AI experiences for chat, email, and voice—enabling businesses to deploy autonomous AI agents that deliver human-like, context-aware support at scale. Previously, at Respond.io, a $20M ARR company, I led the development of AI agent infrastructure powering multi-channel conversational support, processing over 13 million daily messages across global businesses. Experienced in micro-services, AWS, and high-performance backend architectures, I'm passionate about creating intelligent, user-centric digital products that redefine how people interact with technology.
